id: 736-賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服卡拉克穆爾

battle.name: 賈索·錢·卡維爾一世征服卡拉克穆爾
battle.brief: 公元736年，卡拉克穆爾的蛇王朝在佩滕—坎佩切低地對蒂卡爾及普克諸邦打出決定性一仗：蒂卡爾的敗績見於743年豎立的31號石碑，烏克斯特佩通的紀念碑亦在七三〇年代末停工。卡面的希臘重步兵屬古典地中海的方陣裝備，未曾出現在瑪雅戰場，與之功能相當的是佩槍的獵豹武士與擲矛手。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 這場戰爭發生於公元736年，戰場在瑪雅文明北部低地的佩滕與坎佩切之間，即今墨西哥坎佩切州與瓜地馬拉佩滕省的亞伯斯谷地，以及普克高原的北緣。交戰一方是卡拉克穆爾（Kaanul，蛇之地）的蛇王朝君主，即戰爭列表所記的賈索·錢·卡維爾一世一系；其部隊由卡拉克穆爾核心城區抽調的常備與半常備兵員為主，加上受其控制的普克地區盟邦軍，骨幹是佩槍的精英戰士與以擲矛器、弓箭為主的城邦民兵。另一方是仍保有獨立的蒂卡爾及其盟友網絡，涵蓋佩滕東部的城邦以及多斯皮拉斯—卡拉科爾集團：蒂卡爾守軍以步兵為主，配備擲矛器、投石索、弓與獵豹紋圓盾，並有數量不多的重裝突擊單位。第三方包括保持觀望的南方城邦，如科潘與亞伯斯谷地的其他小國，捲入的是卡拉克穆爾稱霸低地的整體壓力，而非直接參戰。必須說明的是，卡拉克穆爾本身正是賈索·錢·卡維爾一世一系所統治的城邦；戰爭列表把君主姓名與城邦名並列，源於戰爭總表把這一系列戰役一律繫於卡拉克穆爾的征服名下，而碑銘研究則把它們記為蛇王朝對周邊城邦的兼併。
countriesEn: This war took place in AD 736 in the northern Maya lowlands, between Petén and Campeche, that is, in the region of the Río Bec in present-day Campeche State of Mexico and Petén Department of Guatemala, together with the northern rim of the Puuc plateau. One side was the Snake dynasty of Calakmul (Kaanul, the Place of the Serpent), that is, the line of the ruler recorded in the war lists as Jasaw Chan K'awiil I. His troops consisted mainly of standing and semi-standing levies drawn from the core districts of Calakmul, reinforced by the contingents of Puuc allies under its control, with the backbone formed by dart-throwing elite warriors and by citizen militias equipped with atlatls and bows. The other side was Tikal, still independent, together with its network of allies covering the eastern Petén city-states and the Dos Pilas–Caracol grouping: Tikal's defenders were infantry, armed with atlatls, slings, bows and jaguar-skin round shields, together with a small number of heavy assault units. Third parties included southern city-states that watched and waited, such as Copán and the smaller polities of the Bec region; what engulfed them was the general pressure of Calakmul's bid for hegemony over the lowlands rather than direct participation. It must be said that Calakmul was itself the city-state ruled by the line of Jasaw Chan K'awiil I. The war list sets the ruler's name beside the name of the city because the general list of wars files this whole series of campaigns under the conquests of Calakmul, whereas epigraphic scholarship records them as the Snake dynasty's absorption of the neighbouring city-states.
people: 賈索·錢·卡維爾一世（Siyaj Chan K'awiil I）是卡拉克穆爾蛇王朝的開國君主之一，也是中文戰爭列表中736年本役、743年瓦卡之役與744年納蘭霍之役的同一署名人物。瑪雅王室多代君主共用錢·卡維爾這一組王名，因此碑銘學在處理這批征服時，通常把具體行動分別繫於西雅赫·錢·卡維爾一世、雅辛·錢·卡維爾二世及其後繼者，公元736年蒂卡爾的敗績，一般認為是卡拉克穆爾王權在雅辛一系手上的成果。蒂卡爾方面的關鍵人物是葉什·努恩·阿欣一世（Yax Nuun Ahiin I，綽號葉片美洲虎），他在位期間先後捱過與卡拉科爾的第十二次星際大戰（735）與卡拉克穆爾的進攻，並在743年主持豎立記錄本役的蒂卡爾31號石碑。背景人物則有：多斯皮拉斯的君主努恩·烏卓爾·查克，他在692年弒殺蒂卡爾君主西雅赫·錢·卡維爾二世並與卡拉科爾結盟，直接造成八年後卡拉克穆爾介入的局勢；以及卡拉科爾的君主卡克·蒂利烏·錢·約帕特，他於738年入侵科潘，把南方聯盟牽入同一輪戰亂。
peopleEn: Jasaw Chan K'awiil I (Siyaj Chan K'awiil I) was one of the founding rulers of the Snake dynasty of Calakmul, and he is the same named figure who appears in the Chinese war lists for this campaign of AD 736, for the reduction of Waka' in 743 and for the reduction of Naranjo in 744. Several Maya kings reused the royal name element Chan K'awiil, so epigraphic scholarship normally assigns the individual campaigns of this series separately to Siyaj Chan K'awiil I, to Yaxun Chan K'awiil II and to his successors; the defeat inflicted on Tikal in AD 736 is generally ascribed to Calakmul kingship in the hands of the Yaxun line. The key figure on the Tikal side was Yax Nuun Ahiin I, known as Foliated Jaguar, who reigned through the twelfth Star War against Caracol in 735 and through the Calakmul advance that followed, and who in 743 set up Tikal Stela 31, the monument that records the present battle. Figures in the background include Nuun Uchol Chahk, ruler of Dos Pilas, who murdered the Tikal king Siyaj Chan K'awiil II in 692 and then allied with Caracol, directly creating the situation that drew Calakmul in eight years later; and K'ak' Tiliw Chan Yopaat of Caracol, who invaded Copán in 738 and pulled the southern alliance into the same round of warfare.
kits: 本役在瑪雅世界沒有任何希臘式重步兵：卡面上的希臘重步兵屬古典地中海的方陣裝備，重心是圓盾結成的遮蔽正面，作戰時以縱深約八列的方陣緩慢推進，臂盾相接之下，一支部隊的正面比單兵結實得多，而這套裝備與瑪雅低地的兵制毫無關係。實際投入736年戰役的裝備，以擲矛器（atlatl，瑪雅語 ch'ok）配木鏃短矛最為普遍，射手站在散兵線上反覆投射；弓與箭在七、八世紀的瑪雅已屬常見，多數箭鏃為燧石，箭桿為木。破壞力最大的近身武器是馬卡維特爾（macuahuitl），即嵌了黑曜石刃的木製劍狀兵器，須雙手揮擊；另有石斧、黑曜石刃棍與套在指上的獵豹爪套。防護上，城邦民兵多披以棉絮填充的夾層棉甲，護以圓盾（chictli，覆獸皮的木盾），精英階層另有護肩、背板與頭盔，並以石刻的戰狼名號組織突擊單位。攻城與後勤器具同樣重要：薩克貝（sacbe）白灰石道路、聚落外圍的木柵與土壘，以及供遠征屯糧的坑屋；運輸則完全依靠人力背負與河道獨木舟。
kitsEn: There was not a single Greek heavy infantryman in this war: the hoplite on the card belongs to the phalanx equipment of the classical Mediterranean, whose whole weight rests on a sheltered front made by round shields locked together, advancing slowly in a formation roughly eight ranks deep, so that a unit in line was far tougher than any individual, and none of this has the least connection to Maya lowland warfare. The equipment actually employed in AD 736 was above all the atlatl (Maya ch'ok) with wooden-tipped darts, the throwers standing in loose order and hurling repeatedly; the bow and arrow were already common in seventh- and eighth-century Maya hands, with mostly flint heads and wooden shafts. The most destructive close-combat weapon was the macuahuitl, a wooden club-sword with inset obsidian blades that had to be swung with both hands; there were also stone axes, obsidian-edged clubs and feline claw sets worn on the fingers. For protection, citizen militia generally wore quilted cotton armour over a padded cotton core and carried a round shield (chictli, a wooden shield covered with hide); the elite had shoulder guards, back plates and helmets as well, and organised assault units under the stone-carved name of the war dog. Siege and logistics gear mattered just as much: the white limestone sacbe roads, the wooden palisades and earthen ramparts around settlements, and the store-huts that provisioned distant campaigns; transport was entirely by human porters and by river canoe.
tactics: 瑪雅人沒有留下戰術條令，本役的作戰方式只能由碑銘、考古遺址與同時期其他衝突推想而得。卡拉克穆爾方面的打法是典型的高原與低地城邦聯盟作戰：主力步兵以散兵線前進，擲矛手與弓箭手輪流射擊，消耗對方並迫使敵軍結陣；一旦對方陣線出現缺口，佩槍的獵豹武士即從側翼突入，以馬卡維特爾與石斧砍殺落單者，而這些突擊單位正是卡面上希臘重步兵在功能上最接近的對應物。當對手是蒂卡爾這類築有城牆與台基的城邦時，進攻往往不以強攻為先，而是先切斷其盟友、奪取水路與陸路補給，再以長期封鎖迫使其屈服；普克地區的薩克貝道路網既是商路，也是軍隊推進的骨幹，但整段推進速度受季風雨季限制。圍城階段，進攻方依賴屯糧維持遠征，防守方則以城牆、壕溝與石制台基構成多層障礙；蒂卡爾這類城邦的守軍通常把城門前的狹窄通道與通往台基群的階梯視為防禦要點，調動城內民兵佔居高處，居高臨下以擲矛與投石支援前沿。
tacticsEn: The Maya left no manual of tactics, so the way this battle was fought can only be reconstructed from monuments, archaeological remains and other conflicts of the same period. The Calakmul side fought as a league of lowland and highland city-states usually did: the main infantry advanced in loose order, atlatl throwers and archers taking turns in shooting to wear the enemy down and force him to close up; once a gap opened in the opposing line, the dart-throwing jaguar warriors would strike in from the flank and cut down men caught alone with macuahuitl and axe, and these assault units are the closest functional counterparts to the hoplite on the card. When the opponent was a city like Tikal, walled and set on platform mounds, direct assault was seldom the first step: the attacker would instead cut the city off from its allies, seize the water and land routes of supply, and then use a long blockade to force a surrender. The sacbe road network of the Puuc region was both trade route and spine of the army's advance, though the pace of the whole movement was at the mercy of the rainy season. In the siege phase the besieger depended on stored provisions to feed a far-flung army, while the defenders built layered obstacles out of wall, ditch and stone platform; in towns such as Tikal the garrison treated the narrow approaches before the gates and the stairways up to the platform mounds as the decisive points, pulling militia onto high ground to support the front line from above with darts and sling stones.
data: 關於本役的數字，史料只留下零星刻記，兵員幾乎沒有可靠記載。已知者是幾個可以核對的時空量度：卡拉克穆爾遺址的核心區面積約二十平方公里，據勘測有數千座建築基址，其政權鼎盛期的人口一般估計在數萬至十萬之間；蒂卡爾同期人口約一萬至兩萬。由此推算，一次城邦聯盟能拉上陣的戰士應以數千計，而非數萬。距離方面，蒂卡爾至卡拉克穆爾直線約一百三十公里，至烏克斯特佩通約三百公里，正是736年之後卡拉克穆爾把勢力推向普克區所必須跨越的縱深。時間上，本役繫於公元736年，具體月份無刻記可考；按瑪雅長曆換算，同系列的大事多落在旱季末，例如公元695年9.13.0.0對應公曆十二月下旬，可見這類遠征常在年末乾月出發。傷亡數字無從核對，碑銘只記勝負與俘獲。投射物的消耗以每位射手每日數十發計，糧食、燃料與牲畜全靠背負的隊伍運過三百公里山地，隊伍規模因此受到嚴格限制。
dataEn: For numbers, the record preserves only scattered inscriptions and almost nothing reliable about the size of the armies. What is known amounts to a few checkable measures of time and distance. The core area of the Calakmul site covers roughly twenty square kilometres, with several thousand building platforms recorded by survey, and the population of its polity at its height is generally estimated at somewhere between tens of thousands and a hundred thousand; Tikal's contemporary population was of the order of ten to twenty thousand. It follows that a city-state league could put a few thousand warriors in the field, not tens of thousands. As for distance, Tikal lies about one hundred and thirty kilometres from Calakmul in a straight line and about three hundred kilometres from Uxte Petun, and it is precisely that depth of country that Calakmul had to cross after 736 in pushing its power into the Puuc region. As for time, the campaign is fixed to AD 736, and no inscription preserves the month; by Long Count reckoning, the great events of the same series tend to fall at the end of the dry season, for instance 9.13.0.0 in AD 695 corresponding to late December of the modern calendar, which shows that such campaigns customarily set out in the dry months at year's end. Casualty figures cannot be checked at all: the monuments record only victory, defeat and capture. Expenditure of missiles is estimated at several dozen throws per archer per day, while food, fuel and beasts of burden travelled the three hundred kilometres of upland on the backs of porters, which strictly limited the size of the marching column.
cause: 這場衝突的起因，是公元七世紀末至八世紀初低地政治格局的失衡。蒂卡爾在第一次與第二次蒂卡爾—卡拉克穆爾戰爭（562年、695年）之後被迫收縮，中部佩滕的大片城址淪為廢墟，人口外流到北方與南方；與此同時，蛇王朝在卡拉克穆爾整合了佩滕北部的資源與普克地區的農業，得以在八世紀前期連續出兵。導火索是城邦間既有盟約的崩解：多斯皮拉斯在692年弒殺蒂卡爾君主西雅赫·錢·卡維爾二世後與卡拉科爾結盟，觸發735年的第十二次星際大戰；735年卡拉科爾再敗蒂卡爾之後，736年卡拉克穆爾的軍隊隨即深入，使蒂卡爾的處境與其南方盟友連成一氣。對卡拉克穆爾一方而言，壓服蒂卡爾的抵抗，等於打開通往普克與南部資源的路線；對蒂卡爾一方而言，唯一可選的是死守台基群與城牆，等待援軍或內部重新整合。
causeEn: The immediate cause of this clash was the disequilibrium in lowland politics between the late seventh and the early eighth century. After the first and second Tikal–Calakmul wars, in 562 and 695, Tikal had been forced to contract: large tracts of central Petén fell out of use, and population drained north and south. At the same time the Snake dynasty consolidated the resources of northern Petén and the agriculture of the Puuc region at Calakmul, which allowed it to campaign repeatedly in the early eighth century. The trigger was the breakdown of the old alliances between city-states: after Dos Pilas murdered the Tikal king Siyaj Chan K'awiil II in 692 and allied with Caracol, the twelfth Star War was set off in 735; and once Caracol had beaten Tikal again in 735, the Calakmul armies pushed in during 736, joining Tikal's plight to that of its southern allies. For the Calakmul side, crushing Tikal's resistance meant opening the road to the resources of the Puuc and the south; for Tikal the only course was to hold the platform mounds and the walls, waiting either for relief or for a new internal consolidation.
impact: 本役的直接結果，是蒂卡爾在低地的霸權就此終結。743年豎立的蒂卡爾31號石碑記載了這場敗績與其後的朝貢，蒂卡爾自「葉片美洲虎」的失敗為起點，在742年被迫向卡拉克穆爾繳納貢賦，城邦在政治上降為附庸，此後六百年間再未回到獨立霸主的地位。區域層面上，736年之後普克諸城邦相繼崩解或改換宗主：烏克斯特佩通的紀念碑在七三〇年代末突然停工，城市隨後被放棄；瓦卡在743年被取，納蘭霍在744年被取；南方聯盟瓦解後，位置偏北的卡拉克穆爾成為低地唯一的強權。但這份霸權並不穩固：八世紀中葉起南方低地普遍出現饑荒與政治崩解，750年前後卡拉克穆爾放棄南方盟友與普克據點，隨後自身也在九世紀之前從記載中淡出，晚期古典期於焉收場，瑪雅世界進入中世紀期。
impactEn: The direct result of the campaign was the end of Tikal's hegemony in the lowlands. Tikal Stela 31, set up in 743, records this defeat and the tribute that followed; beginning with the failure of Foliated Jaguar, Tikal was forced in 742 to pay tribute to Calakmul, dropped politically into the status of a vassal, and never again stood as an independent great power over the following six hundred years. At regional level, after 736 the Puuc city-states collapsed in turn or changed overlords: the monuments of Uxte Petun stop abruptly in the late 730s and the city was afterwards abandoned; Waka' was taken in 743 and Naranjo in 744. With the southern alliance network dissolved, Calakmul, sitting further north, became the only power in the lowlands. Yet that hegemony was not secure: from the middle of the eighth century famine and political breakdown spread across the southern lowlands, and around AD 750 Calakmul let go of its southern allies and Puuc outposts before itself fading from the record before the ninth century. The Terminal Classic thus closed, and the Maya world entered the Medieval period.
result: 結局是卡拉克穆爾方面的完勝：蒂卡爾在736年陷於敗績，743年碑銘記下的敗績與742年的朝貢，把低地最後一個獨立對手壓入附庸地位；普克方向的城市隨後接連易主，瓦卡（743）與納蘭霍（744）的陷落標誌著蛇王朝霸權達到頂點。此役沒有留下戰場全過程的記錄，勝負是從碑銘的表述、城市的荒廢與盟約的瓦解拼湊出來的：蒂卡爾31號石碑、納蘭霍與烏克斯特佩通紀念碑的停工時序、以及卡拉克穆爾自身的紀念碑，都只留下勝與服的結果，沒有留下死傷與戰術的細節。長期看來，卡拉克穆爾的勝利只是把崩解的時鐘推後了十幾年：八世紀末的低地饑荒、乾旱與政治內鬥同時襲來，750年後連卡拉克穆爾自身也放棄南方據點，公元九世紀它不再是強權，晚期古典期的城邦網絡最終瓦解，瑪雅歷史進入與中美洲其他地區一樣的中世紀期。
resultEn: The outcome was an outright victory for the Calakmul side. Tikal was defeated in 736, and the defeat inscribed on the monument of 743 together with the tribute of 742 pressed the last independent power of the lowlands into vassalage; the cities of the Puuc direction then changed hands one after another, and the reduction of Waka' in 743 and of Naranjo in 744 marked the high point of Snake dynasty hegemony. No record of the battle itself survives: the result is pieced together from the wording of the monuments, the abandonment of cities and the dissolution of alliances. Tikal Stela 31, the sequence in which the monuments of Naranjo and Uxte Petun stop, and the stelae of Calakmul itself preserve only victory and submission, leaving no detail of losses or tactics. In the long run Calakmul's success merely postponed the moment of collapse by a little over a decade: famine, drought and political infighting struck the lowlands together at the end of the eighth century; after 750 even Calakmul let its southern outposts go; by the ninth century it was no longer a power; the city-state network of the Terminal Classic finally dissolved, and Maya history passed into a Medieval period like the rest of Mesoamerica.
